exposure: Prenatal care (PNC) utilization (assessed by APNCU Index)
cohort: The study included women carrying fetuses with and without spina bifida, who delivered liveborn infants in California between 2005 and 2012.
finding: More than half of women carrying fetuses with spina bifida did not receive intensive prenatal care, with 21% receiving less-than-adequate care (associated with non-private insurance), and intensive PNC was unexpectedly linked to higher rates of neonatal complications in the SB group.
